title: Have You Ever...? — A Street Interview
title_ar: هل عملت قبل كده؟ — مقابلة في الشارع
gist_ar: مقابلة قصيرة مع هالة: عمرها ما سافرت بره مصر، لكن الكلام المستمر هو اللي غيّر حياتها.

before_listening.en: A reporter interviews one person. Listen for the POINT Hala is making, not her details.
before_listening.ar: مراسل بيقابل واحدة. ركّز على الفكرة اللي هالة عايزة توصّلها، مش تفاصيلها.

segments.speaker: Reporter
segments.text: We're asking one question today: have you ever done something that changed your life? Here's Hala.

segments.speaker: Hala
segments.text: Yes. I have never left Egypt, but I have learned three languages from my phone. Ten years ago I had never spoken to a foreigner. Then I started working in a hotel in Hurghada, and suddenly I was speaking English every day. I have made so many mistakes, hundreds of them, but I have never stopped talking. My sister has studied English for six years at school, and she has never had a real conversation. That is the difference. It isn't about travelling. I have been in the same city all my life, and English still opened a door for me.

segments.speaker: Reporter
segments.text: Hala, thank you. If you have a story like this one, send us a message.

gist_question.q_ar: إيه الفكرة اللي هالة عايزة توصّلها؟
options: You have to travel abroad to learn a language
You have to study at school for six years
You do not need to travel; you need to keep speaking

questions.q_ar: هالة سافرت بره مصر قبل كده؟

questions.q: Where did she start speaking English every day?
questions.q_ar: فين بدأت تتكلم إنجليزي كل يوم؟

questions.q: What does she say about her sister?
options: She has studied for six years but never had a real conversation
She has travelled and speaks better
She has learned three languages too
